enable_build_where_you_stand.description: If enabled, you can place blocks at the position (feet + eye level) where you stand.

cinematic_camera_smoothing.description: Smooths rotation of camera in cinematic mode.

aux1_descends.description: If enabled, "Aux1" key instead of "Sneak" key is used for climbing down and descending.

doubletap_jump.description: Double-tapping the jump key toggles fly mode.

always_fly_fast.description: If disabled, "Aux1" key is used to fly fast if both fly and fast mode are enabled.

repeat_place_time.description: The time in seconds it takes between repeated node placements when holding the place button.

safe_dig_and_place.description: Prevent digging and placing from repeating when holding the mouse buttons.

touchscreen_threshold.description: The length in pixels it takes for touch screen interaction to start.

fixed_virtual_joystick.description: (Android) Fixes the position of virtual joystick.

virtual_joystick_triggers_aux1.description: (Android) Use virtual joystick to trigger "Aux1" button.

screen_w.description: Width component of the initial window size.

screen_h.description: Height component of the initial window size.

autosave_screensize.description: Save window size automatically when modified.

pause_on_lost_focus.description: Open the pause menu when the window's focus is lost.

fps_max.description: Limit FPS to not waste CPU power.

fps_max_unfocused.description: Maximum FPS when the window is not focused, or when the game is paused.

connected_glass.description: Connects glass if supported by node.

smooth_lighting.description: Enable smooth lighting with simple ambient occlusion.

performance_tradeoffs.description: Enables tradeoffs that reduce CPU load or increase rendering performance.

enable_particles.description: Adds particles when digging a node.

arm_inertia.description: Arm inertia, gives a more realistic movement of the arm when the camera moves.

view_bobbing_amount.description: Enable view bobbing and amount of view bobbing.

near_plane.description: Camera 'near clipping plane' distance in nodes.

display_gamma.description: Alters the light curve by applying 'gamma correction' to it.

ambient_occlusion_gamma.description: The strength (darkness) of node ambient-occlusion shading.

screenshot_quality.description: Screenshot quality. Only used for JPEG format.

node_highlighting.description: Method used to highlight selected object.

selectionbox_width.description: Width of the selection box lines around nodes.

enable_fog.description: Whether to fog out the end of the visible area.

directional_colored_fog.description: Make fog and sky colors depend on daytime and view direction.

fog_start.description: Fraction of the visible distance at which fog starts to be rendered.

enable_clouds.description: Clouds are a client side effect.

enable_3d_clouds.description: Use 3D cloud look instead of flat.

anisotropic_filter.description: Use anisotropic filtering when viewing at textures from an angle.

bilinear_filter.description: Use bilinear filtering when scaling textures.

trilinear_filter.description: Use trilinear filtering when scaling textures.

texture_clean_transparent.description: Apply a filter to clean up blended RGB values with fully-transparent neighbors.

texture_min_size.description: Minimum texture size for upscaled textures.

enable_waving_leaves.description: Set to true to enable waving leaves.

enable_waving_plants.description: Set to true to enable waving plants.

enable_waving_water.description: Set to true to enable waving liquids.

water_wave_height.description: The maximum height of the surface of waving liquids.

water_wave_speed.description: How fast liquid waves will move.

enable_dynamic_shadows.description: Set to true to enable Shadow Mapping.

shadow_map_texture_size.description: Texture size to render the shadow map on.

shadow_map_texture_32bit.description: Sets shadow texture quality to 32 bits.

shadow_update_frames.description: Spread a complete update of shadow map over given amount of frames.

shadow_soft_radius.description: Set the soft shadow radius size.

shadow_sky_body_orbit_tilt.description: Set the tilt of Sun/Moon orbit in degrees.

language.description: Set the language. Leave empty to use the system language.

gui_scaling.description: Scale GUI by a user specified value.

gui_scaling_filter_txr2img.description: Copy images from hardware to software for scaling.

tooltip_show_delay.description: Delay showing tooltips, stated in milliseconds.

menu_clouds.description: Use a cloud animation for the main menu background.

hud_scaling.description: Modifies the size of the HUD elements.

show_nametag_backgrounds.description: Whether name tag backgrounds should be shown by default.

recent_chat_messages.description: Maximum number of recent chat messages to show.

hud_hotbar_max_width.description: Maximum proportion of current window to be used for hotbar.

clickable_chat_weblinks.description: Clickable weblinks enabled in chat console output.

chat_weblink_color.description: Optional override for chat weblink color.

chat_font_size.description: Font size of the recent chat text and chat prompt in point (pt).

contentdb_url.description: The URL for the content repository.

contentdb_flag_blacklist.description: Comma-separated list of flags to hide in the content repository.

enable_local_map_saving.description: Save the map received by the client on disk.

serverlist_url.description: URL to the server list displayed in the Multiplayer Tab.

enable_split_login_register.description: If enabled, account registration is separate from login in the UI.

server_name.description: Name of the server, to be displayed when players join and in the serverlist.

server_description.description: Description of server, to be displayed when players join and in the serverlist.

server_address.description: Domain name of server, to be displayed in the serverlist.

server_url.description: Homepage of server, to be displayed in the serverlist.

motd.description: Message of the day displayed to players connecting.

max_users.description: Maximum number of players that can be connected simultaneously.

static_spawnpoint.description: If this is set, players will always (re)spawn at the given position.

bind_address.description: The network interface that the server listens on.

strict_protocol_version_checking.description: Enable to disallow old clients from connecting.

remote_media.description: Specifies URL from which client fetches media instead of using UDP.

default_password.description: New users need to input this password.

disallow_empty_password.description: If enabled, players cannot join without a password.

default_privs.description: The privileges that new users automatically get.

basic_privs.description: Privileges that players with basic_privs can grant.

disable_anticheat.description: If enabled, disable cheat prevention in multiplayer.

enable_rollback_recording.description: If enabled, actions are recorded for rollback.

csm_restriction_flags.description: Restricts the access of certain client-side functions on servers.

csm_restriction_noderange.description: If the CSM restriction for node range is enabled, get_node calls are limited to this distance.

strip_color_codes.description: Remove color codes from incoming chat messages.

chat_message_max_size.description: Set the maximum length of a chat message (in characters) sent by clients.

chat_message_limit_per_10sec.description: Amount of messages a player may send per 10 seconds.

chat_message_limit_trigger_kick.description: Kick players who sent more than X messages per 10 seconds.

world_start_time.description: Time of day when a new world is started, in millihours (0-23999).

item_entity_ttl.description: Time in seconds for item entity (dropped items) to live.

default_stack_max.description: Specifies the default stack size of nodes, items and tools.

movement_acceleration_default.description: Horizontal and vertical acceleration on ground or when climbing.

movement_acceleration_air.description: Horizontal acceleration in air when jumping or falling.

movement_acceleration_fast.description: Horizontal and vertical acceleration in fast mode.

movement_speed_walk.description: Walking and flying speed, in nodes per second.

movement_speed_crouch.description: Sneaking speed, in nodes per second.

movement_speed_fast.description: Walking, flying and climbing speed in fast mode, in nodes per second.

movement_speed_climb.description: Vertical climbing speed, in nodes per second.

movement_speed_jump.description: Initial vertical speed when jumping, in nodes per second.

movement_liquid_fluidity.description: How much you are slowed down when moving inside a liquid.

movement_liquid_sink.description: Controls sinking speed in liquid when idling.

movement_gravity.description: Acceleration of gravity, in nodes per second per second.

fixed_map_seed.description: A chosen map seed for a new map, leave empty for random.

mg_name.description: Name of map generator to be used when creating a new world.

water_level.description: Water surface level of the world.

max_block_generate_distance.description: From how far blocks are generated for clients, stated in mapblocks (16 nodes).

mapgen_limit.description: Limit of map generation, in nodes, in all 6 directions from (0, 0, 0).

mgv5_spflags.description: Map generation attributes specific to Mapgen v5.

mgv5_large_cave_depth.description: Y of upper limit of large caves.

mgv5_small_cave_num_min.description: Minimum limit of random number of small caves per mapchunk.

mgv5_small_cave_num_max.description: Maximum limit of random number of small caves per mapchunk.

mgv5_large_cave_num_min.description: Minimum limit of random number of large caves per mapchunk.

mgv5_large_cave_num_max.description: Maximum limit of random number of large caves per mapchunk.

mgv5_large_cave_flooded.description: Proportion of large caves that contain liquid.

mgv5_cavern_taper.description: Y-distance over which caverns expand to full size.

mgv6_freq_desert.description: Deserts occur when np_biome exceeds this value.

mgv6_freq_beach.description: Sandy beaches occur when np_beach exceeds this value.

mgv7_floatland_taper.description: Y-distance over which floatlands taper from full density to nothing.

mgv7_floatland_density.description: Adjusts the density of the floatland layer.

mgv7_floatland_ywater.description: Surface level of optional water placed on a solid floatland layer.

mgv7_cavern_taper.description: Y-distance over which caverns expand to full size.

mgcarpathian_valley_width.description: Defines the width of the river valley.

mgcarpathian_small_cave_num_max.description: Maximum limit of random number of small caves per mapchunk.

mgcarpathian_large_cave_flooded.description: Proportion of large caves that contain liquid.
